title: Compaction, decay and reinforcement in a two-tier conversational memory: a paired evaluation against retrieval-augmented generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.09807v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A conversational agent that remembers has to decide what to keep. Retrieval-augmented generation keeps the transcript and searches it; the alternative is to compact each turn into atomic facts and search those. We compare the two on LoCoMo, with both arms answering all 1,985 questions in one window, against the same stores, with the same generator and judge, and both predictions on one row, which licenses McNemar's exact test on the 512 questions where they disagree.   On the four categories comparable work reports, compaction scores 71.4 per cent against 64.6, a lead of 6.8 points (p = 5.5e-08) at 34 per cent fewer prompt tokens. On all five, including the adversarial set comparable work drops, the lead falls to 2.0 and stops being significant, because the baseline leads adversarial by 14.6.   That loss has a structure. translated_title: 两层对话记忆中的压缩、衰减与强化：与检索增强生成的配对评估
translated_abstract: 一个具备记忆能力的对话代理必须决定保留什么内容。检索增强生成（RAG）保留完整的对话记录并进行搜索；另一种方案是将每一轮对话压缩为原子事实并检索这些事实。我们在 LoCoMo 数据集上对这两种方法进行比较：两条方法在单一窗口内回答全部 1,985 个问题，使用相同的存储、相同的生成器和评判者，且两个预测结果放在同一行上，这使得我们可以在两者不一致的 512 个问题上进行 McNemar 精确检验。在可比工作所报告的四个类别上，压缩方法取得 71.4% 的成绩，对比组为 64.6%，领先 6.8 个百分点（p = 5.5e-08），且提示 token 减少 34%。而在包括对抗性集合（可比工作通常会略去）的全部五个类别上，领先幅度降至 2.0 且不再显著，原因是基线在对抗性集合上领先 14.6。这一损失具有结构性规律：我们的领先优势随着参考答案对源文措辞要求的增加而下降——在一到两个参考词时领先 9.6 个百分点，而在……
tldr: 该论文提出将对话逐轮压缩为原子事实的两层记忆机制，通过严格的配对评估证明其比检索增强生成（RAG）准确率高 6.8 个百分点且提示 token 减少 34%，但优势会随问题措辞要求和对抗性问题的增加而减弱。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-tier conversational memory that compacts each turn into atomic facts, demonstrating through a rigorously paired evaluation a significant 6.8-point accuracy lead over retrieval-augmented generation with 34% fewer prompt tokens, though the advantage narrows on adversarial and wording-sensitive questions.
